correctness.rationale: All three allowed local cluster types follow from indistinguishable omitted private twins and complementary domination. The type-C condition is exactly adjacency of its hub to a selected hub, and private signatures make distinct clusters distinguishable. Counting each case gives every coefficient with no double counting. The identity max c_H(A)=n-gamma(H) follows from completing A into a dominating set and attaining equality with a minimum dominating set. Independent direct-definition exhaustive enumeration corroborates this for 90 base-graph/parameter instances; the proof is unrestricted.

evidence: The total-domination condition concerns internal adjacency of every vertex of the selected set, unlike locating domination.
broader_coverage.reasoning: A result for locating total dominating sets cannot enumerate all mixed-role pairs, since this count includes selected classes which fail total domination. A twin-free two-LD partition theorem does not include clique coronas and does not classify ordered LD/D pairs. Neither broader-looking result implies the claimed polynomial.

originality.rationale: Full-text comparison establishes that the central 2026 paper is an existence theorem, not a counting/classification result, and its corona example attaches only one leaf. A 2014 paper covers locating total domination, a strictly different selected-side requirement. The 2025 twin-free two-LD partition framework does not apply to these true-twin clique attachments. Actual semantic record searches and literature searches returned no same-claim or more-general enumerator; this supports provisional originality, not a proof of historical uniqueness.
residual_risks: Historical priority is provisional; an equivalent count may occur under other terminology in incompletely indexed literature.
The threshold-graph locating-domination and the 2014 locating-total-domination literature contain nearby techniques, but their stated results do not directly imply this claim.
The equality concerning gamma(H) is an exact mathematical identity; it does not imply a polynomial-time evaluation algorithm.

value.rationale: The theorem classifies every role-specified mixed LD/dominating partition and all cardinalities on an unrestricted base-graph corona family, beyond known existence results. Its minimum size recovers the arbitrary host domination number exactly and its extremal coefficient counts all optimizers, a motivated refinement with structural and complexity implications.
